title: Pragmatic randomized controlled trial of long-term psychoanalytic psychotherapy for treatment-resistant depression: the Tavistock Adult Depression Study
version_note: Open full article and UCL repository manuscript were read on 2026-07-27. The trial concerns one manualized, once-weekly psychoanalytic psychotherapy added to treatment as usual for a specific treatment-resistant-depression sample; it is not a trial of every psychoanalytic theory or practice.
